Tomato___Early_blight.name: Tomato Early Blight
Tomato___Early_blight.spread_factors: Warm temperatures (24-29°C) accompanied by heavy dews or frequent rains.

severity_rules.early: Infection limited to bottom 2-3 leaves; no fruit involvement.
severity_rules.moderate: Progressing to mid-canopy; lesions expanding with chlorotic halos.
severity_rules.severe: Upper canopy infected; stem cankers and fruit lesions visible.

organic: Spray Neem Oil (5ml/L of water) with emulsifier every 7 days as a prophylactic.
Apply bio-fungicide Trichoderma viride or Pseudomonas fluorescens (5g/L water) in soil & foliage.
Spray Cow Urine (Gomutra 10%) fermented with Dashparni Ark to enhance systemic immunity.
chemical: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2 g/L at first appearance.
For moderate-to-severe infection, spray Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC (Amistar Top) @ 1 ml/L.
Alternatively use Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1.5 ml/L water with sticker.
cultural: Remove and safely burn lower infected leaves (pruning bottom 12 inches).
Ensure drip irrigation to prevent water splashing spores onto lower leaves.
Practice 3-year crop rotation avoiding Solanaceae family plants.

Tomato___Late_blight.name: Tomato Late Blight
Tomato___Late_blight.spread_factors: Cool, humid weather (15-22°C with relative humidity >85% for consecutive days).

severity_rules.early: Water-soaked dark green/black patches on leaf margins.
severity_rules.moderate: White fluffy downy mildew sporulation underneath; spreading to stems.
severity_rules.severe: Foliage collapses completely into black slime; green fruits turn dark greasy brown.

organic: Spray Copper Oxychloride 50% WP (Blitox) @ 3 g/L as certified preventive barrier.
Foliar spray of Potassium Phosphite / Bio-protectants containing Bacillus subtilis.
Ensure good aeration and sunlight penetration through row spacing.
chemical: Systemic: Cymoxanil 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Curzate) @ 2.5 g/L water.
Metalaxyl-M 4% + Mancozeb 64% WP (Ridomil Gold) @ 2.5 g/L at early outbreak.
Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1 g/L mixed with Mancozeb @ 2 g/L for rapid knock-down.
cultural: Immediately pull out and bury severely blighted plants outside the field.
Avoid sprinkler/overhead irrigation entirely during cool foggy mornings.

Potato___Early_blight.name: Potato Early Blight
Potato___Early_blight.spread_factors: Alternating dry and wet periods; temperature 25°C.

severity_rules.early: Target spot concentric rings on oldest bottom leaves.
severity_rules.moderate: Leaf tissue around spots turns necrotic and curls upward.
severity_rules.severe: Premature defoliation; tuber size heavily compromised.

organic: Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) foliar spray.
Trichoderma harzianum tuber treatment before planting + foliar spray.
chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5 g/L or Propineb 70% WP (Antracol) @ 2.5 g/L.
Pyraclostrobin 20% WG (Cabrio Top) @ 1.5 g/L for severe infection.
cultural: Maintain balanced nitrogen fertilization (excess nitrogen prolongs susceptibility).

Potato___Late_blight.name: Potato Late Blight
Potato___Late_blight.spread_factors: Cloudy, rainy weather with temperatures 10-21°C and RH >90%.

severity_rules.early: Dark water-soaked lesions expanding rapidly on leaf margins.
severity_rules.moderate: Stem rot visible; white powdery sporulation in morning dew.

organic: Bordeaux mixture 1% spray as preventive barrier in prone areas.
chemical: Mandipropamid 23.4% SC (Revus) @ 0.8 ml/L.
Fenamidone 10% + Mancozeb 50% WG (Sectin) @ 2.5 g/L.
cultural: De-haulm (cut and destroy tops) 10-15 days prior to harvest to safeguard tubers.

Cotton___Bacterial_blight.name: Cotton Bacterial Blight (Black Arm)
Cotton___Bacterial_blight.spread_factors: Wind-driven rains and warm humid days during boll development.

severity_rules.early: Angular water-soaked leaf spots between small veins.
severity_rules.moderate: Veinal necrosis spreading down petiole causing leaf shedding.
severity_rules.severe: Black girdling lesions on main stems and branches (Black Arm phase).

organic: Seed treatment with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10g/kg seed.
Copper hydroxide spray @ 2 g/L.
chemical: Streptocycline (Streptomycin sulphate + Tetracycline) @ 100 mg/L (1g in 10L water) mixed with Copper Oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5 g/L.
Repeat spray at 12-day interval if rains persist.
cultural: Acid delinting of cotton seed before sowing.
Burn crop residues after final harvest.

Cotton___Bollworm_damage.name: Cotton Pink / American Bollworm Damage
Cotton___Bollworm_damage.spread_factors: Continuous cropping, overlapping generations, favorable night humidity.

severity_rules.early: Flared squares (rosetted flowers), small entry holes in young squares.
severity_rules.moderate: Larvae feeding internally on immature bolls with exterior excreta.
severity_rules.severe: Internal lint blackened; damaged bolls rot or open prematurely.

organic: Install Pheromone traps @ 8 per acre for monitoring (ETL: 8 moths/trap/night for 3 days).
Release Trichogramma bactrae egg parasitoids @ 60,000/acre at weekly intervals.
Spray Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) or Azadirachtin 1500 ppm @ 3 ml/L.
chemical: At initial ETL: Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.5 g/L water.
At mid boll stage: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC (Coragen) @ 0.3 ml/L water.
For severe pink bollworm: Spinetoram 11.7% SC @ 1 ml/L or Flubendiamide 39.35% SC @ 0.5 ml/L.
cultural: Manual destruction of rosetted flowers in first flush.
Avoid extending the cotton crop beyond January to break pest lifecycle.

Sugarcane___Red_rot.name: Sugarcane Red Rot
Sugarcane___Red_rot.spread_factors: Infected setts, standing waterlogging, high humidity (80-90%).

severity_rules.early: Upper leaves show discoloration; red lesion streaks on midrib.
severity_rules.moderate: Stalk loses lustre, shrinks longitudinally; nodal darkening.
severity_rules.severe: Pith turns blood red with horizontal white patches; alcohol odor.

organic: Trichoderma viride sett treatment (10 g/L) for 30 minutes before planting.
Soil application of enriched Trichoderma compost @ 2.5 kg/acre.
chemical: Sett treatment with Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1 g/L or Thiophanate Methyl 70% WP @ 1.5 g/L.
Foliar drenching of base with Carbendazim + Mancozeb (Saaf) @ 2 g/L.
cultural: Use certified disease-free tissue culture seed setts (e.g. resistant varieties like Co 86032 / CoM 0265).
Immediately rogue out and incinerate infected clumps with root system.
Ensure efficient field drainage to eliminate stagnant water pockets.

Soybean___Leaf_blight.name: Soybean Cercospora Leaf Blight & Rust
Soybean___Leaf_blight.hindi_name: सोयाबीन का पत्ता झुलसा व गेरुआ
Soybean___Leaf_blight.spread_factors: Continuous rains with mild temperatures during flowering/pod fill.

severity_rules.early: Minute reddish brown flecks on lower foliage.
severity_rules.moderate: Leathery bronze canopy appearance with pustules on underside.
severity_rules.severe: Premature leaf drop causing stunted pods and shriveled grains.

organic: Spray Bio-fungicide Trichoderma harzianum @ 5g/L water at initiation.
Neem Oil 10,000 ppm @ 2 ml/L as repellent.
chemical: Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1.25 ml/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/L.
Pyraclostrobin 13.3% + Epoxiconazole 5% SE (Opera) @ 1.5 ml/L.
cultural: Avoid high plant density; maintain 45cm row spacing for air circulation.

severity_rules.early: Yellow-green lesions on upper leaf surface.
severity_rules.moderate: Spots coalesce with dark water-soaked centers; fruit spotting.
severity_rules.severe: Extensive defoliation exposing peppers to solar damage.

organic: Copper Hydroxide @ 2 g/L preventive spray.
Bacillus subtilis foliar application.
chemical: Streptocycline @ 1g in 10L water + Copper Oxychloride @ 25g in 10L water.
Kasugamycin 3% SL @ 2 ml/L.
cultural: Use hot water treated seeds (50°C for 25 minutes) before nursery raising.
